$Comment: A goblin breach portal a quest summons with startGoblinBreach (kind: portal): vanilla's first breach (Goblin_Breach_First_Event), the portal into the Guttering Hollows, opened near the player whose quest started it. It leaves the universe's own breach schedule alone: the temple generator still starts vanilla's first breach and the recurring ones after it. Repeats until a player has been through, then completes. Not persisted.
